difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that a map satisfying the P-ring type hypothesis is universally injective, and its proof is a 39-line argument with only one external pointer in the whole span. It starts from the injectivity of the map in question, then shows that this injectivity survives an arbitrary base change by writing the base changed map as a filtered colimit of maps of finite type and applying the absolute integral closedness hypothesis that the surrounding section is about. The reduction to finite type and the passage to the colimit are the two steps that a reader has to follow, and both are carried out in the source.
